### Feature summary

There's the script to extract all RTDE fields from the docs in https://github.com/UniversalRobots/Universal_Robots_Client_Library/blob/master/tests/resources/generate_rtde_outputs.py

We removed the tests utilizing it in https://github.com/UniversalRobots/Universal_Robots_Client_Library/pull/597 but this script could still be used to update the [exhaustive_rtde_output_recipe.txt](https://github.com/UniversalRobots/Universal_Robots_Client_Library/blob/master/tests/resources/exhaustive_rtde_output_recipe.txt) and the static list in [fake_rtde_server.cpp](https://github.com/UniversalRobots/Universal_Robots_Client_Library/blob/master/tests/fake_rtde_server.cpp).

The idea is that it checks for updates regularly and then automatically opens a PR if there are any changes, similar to https://github.com/UniversalRobots/Universal_Robots_Client_Library/blob/master/.github/workflows/check_error_codes.yml

### Tasks
*To complete this issue involves*
- [ ] Implement the feature
new_candidates.title: Automatically update the exhaustive recipe and fake RTDE server with new fields

new_candidates.body:
### Feature summary

In our kinematics config we use RPY values, we could change that to quaternions.

This is a follow-up task from https://github.com/UniversalRobots/Universal_Robots_ROS2_Driver/pull/2030. If the kinematics file would be using quaternions we would get rid of ambiguities completely. URDF specification 1.1 supports using quaternions in origins (see https://github.com/ros/urdfdom)

This would require updating the description simultaneously.

This change should only go to Rolling and not modify existing releases. Technically, on Lyrical this wouldn't probably break things, as urdfdom and urdfdom_headers are released with recent enough versions there, but I would like to avoid changing the URDF specification version inside a released distro.

### Tasks
*To complete this issue involves*
- [ ] Make the calibration extraction generate yaml files containing quaterions rather than RPY
- [ ] Make the description read quaternions rather than RPY values from the kinematics config
  - [ ] Think about a fallback path reading RPY to be able to read old configs
- [ ] Make documentation
- [ ] Make Unit test
- [ ] Add migration notes for
  - [ ] description
  - [ ] calibration extraction
- [ ] Test on real hardware
new_candidates.title: Use quaternions for calibration parameters
